title: Click chemistry of phenyl 1,2,3-triazole–2-pyridylpiperazine hybrids: synthesis, targeted anticancer activity, molecular modeling and computational studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25330-25347
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01413E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tamer El Malah, Ahmed A. El-Rashedy
Novel phenyl triazole-pyridylpiperazine derivatives were synthesized & tested against cancer cells. Compounds 15 & 18 showed potent anticancer activity comparable to doxorubicin, with favorable ADME profiles & stable EGFR binding.
